user.title: Sign in to ROBAM
user.description: Use the phone number and password of your ROBAM / ROKI account.

devices.title: Select devices
devices.description: Select the appliances to add to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The session for {phone} expired. Enter the password again.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the ROBAM cloud, try again later
error.invalid_levels: Enter positive levels separated by commas, for example 1,2,3,6

abort.no_supported_devices: No supported appliance was found on this account (it must be powered and online)

draft_profile.name: Draft a profile
draft_profile.description: Create a read-only profile draft and fixture from the cached device properties. No command is sent to the appliance and no cloud request is made.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Pick a ROBAM ROKI device from the device registry (mutually exclusive with guid).

guid.name: Device GUID
guid.description: Target a device by GUID (mutually exclusive with device_id; rarely needed).

write_fixture.name: Write a fixture
write_fixture.description: Also save a regression fixture for the draft (default on).

learn_start.name: Start learning a device
learn_start.description: Passively record the commands the official App sends to this device for up to ten minutes. No command is sent to the appliance.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device to learn (mutually exclusive with guid).

guid.name: Device GUID
guid.description: Target a device by GUID (mutually exclusive with device_id).

learn_stop.name: Stop learning
learn_stop.description: Finish the current learning session and return the recorded actions and observed property changes.

device_id.name: Device (optional)
device_id.description: Check that the session belongs to this device.

profile_parse_failed.title: Profile cannot be parsed
profile_parse_failed.description:
The file {path} could not be loaded: {error}

This issue disappears automatically once the file is fixed.

profile_conflict.title: Profile match conflict
profile_conflict.description:
The device {device} (dc={dc}) is matched equally well by several profiles: {profiles}.

Make one match more specific (for example add dt) or remove the extra files.

unverified_controls_enabled.title: Unverified controls are allowed
unverified_controls_enabled.description:
The allow-unverified-controls option is on: unverified commands from learning mode or a hand-written profile become real entities and may act unexpectedly on the appliance.

Check each one against the official App, then set verified to true in the profile and turn this option off.

data.countdown_auto_off: Turn the hood off when the countdown ends (the appliance itself only beeps)
